header: What logistics managers say about our drivers

testimonials.quote: The 21:00 departure left Oslo on time in 51 of 52 weeks. Our store managers no longer phone us to ask where the chilled pallets are.
Four fixed delivery windows a day let us remove 5,000 units of buffer stock from the yard. The drivers know our gate procedure better than some of our staff.
When a trailer broke down south of Bologna, the depot loaded a replacement within three hours. They told us before we noticed.
